qa_pairs.question: How has the Passenger Baggage Allowance for land-arriving passengers changed regarding monetary tax exemptions and frequency limits over time?
qa_pairs.answer: The baggage allowance for land passengers was initially set at a $300 USD tax-free limit [0, 1, 2]. This was later increased to $400 USD [3, 4]. Most recently, the regulations introduced a frequency limitation, stipulating that this tax-free allowance cannot be claimed more than 3 times per calendar year [5, 6, 7, 8].
